description: Format and lint SQL: consistent keyword case, one clause per line, indented select lists, joins, AND/OR conditions and subqueries, comments and string literals preserved; or minify. The linter flags UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, SELECT *, implicit comma joins, leading-wildcard LIKE, ORDER BY RAND(), NOT IN with subqueries and string-concatenation injection smells, and lists statement types and referenced tables. POST JSON body {sql}. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sql-format
name: sql_format
title: Sql Format
